newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cerus sold Cofir stake for 648 mln Ffr.
newsitem.headline: Cerus sold Cofir stake for 648 mln Ffr.

text.p: Cerus, Italian businessman Carlo De Benedetti's French holding company, said on Thursday that it had sold its 48.05 percent stake in Cofir for 16.2 billion pesetas, or 648 million francs, through placements.

It said in a statement that the sale would boost its cash to 683 million francs after operating fees, or 20 francs per share. But the sale will entail a capital loss of 60 million francs in its consolidated results because the depreciation of the peseta since Cofir's creation in 1987 would result in an accounting loss of 211 million francs. Cerus said the sale optimised the value of the asset for Cerus shareholders.
